selectionBasis: exact-head Blender camera evidence plus manual desktop/mobile comparison

evidence.manifestHashAudit: 36/36 PNG outputs matched recorded SHA-256 and byte length
evidence.reproducibility: R0/R1/R2/R3 pushkinViewing decoded pixels reproduced between the diagnostic 12e5798c artifact and exact-head 7637010e artifact

R0.reason: Known frozen benchmark failure: Pushkin portrait proxy dominates the view, mobile framing is clipped and documentary context is effectively lost.

R1.reason: Best focus-zone transition among unobstructed candidates: restores room/document context, removes more dominant vertical architectural occlusion than R3, keeps the Pushkin anchor fully inside mobile framing and preserves the five already-certified H3 journey cameras unchanged.

R2.reason: Automatic ray-occlusion failure: pushkinViewing hits HUMAN_PROXY before EXHIBIT_alexander-pushkin.

R3.reason: Valid unobstructed fallback with restrained 35 mm perspective and slightly better document-case centering, but manual comparison shows stronger vertical architectural occlusion and a weaker transition from pushkinApproach into the focus zone than R1.
